about.headline: Why Khtain exists.
about.intro: Khtain Block Technology Ltd. is an Alberta corporation founded in 2026. The company holds two operating divisions and one research lab. It exists to make sure that as the layer between businesses and their customers changes — from search engines to language models — the businesses that have something real to offer are not lost in the translation.

origin.body: Khtain was built first to serve Futurefrontier Technology Ltd., a Calgary-based residential solar PV installer, as our first AI Search Visibility case study. Watching a real local business move from 'AI doesn't know who we are' to 'AI can describe, cite, and recommend us accurately' became the proof we needed. Now we offer the same methodology to other Calgary and Alberta businesses, and to bilingual English-Chinese companies who need to be visible in both languages of the AI conversation.
